sections.heading: Norvan 4 Nivalis GTX Grotto Shoe Men's
sections.body: Run through the winter in the Norvan Nivalis. The stable, adaptable Norvan, built for varied terrain, gets a watertight upgrade with a GORE-TEX upper cover and over-ankle gaiter to seal out snow and water, keeping your feet dry. Tread confidently on snow and mud with winter-optimized outsole lugs, and when it’s icy, easily add carbide spikes or slip on microspikes. When winter is at its harshest, don't break stride—the Norvan Nivalis is your weatherproof standby.

sections.body: Athlete-inspired and built for speed, this is the shoe for mountain runners looking to move faster on technical trails. The midsole’s rocker geometry drives propulsion and is made from InFuse, a light, highly responsive EVA and Polyolefin composition that provides rebound and absorbs shock. The fit locks tight, and a knit collar seals out debris.

A TPU shank and toe cap add protection, and a knit collar seals out debris. Need a non-waterproof version? Try the Vertex Alpine Shoe .

sections.heading: Norvan LD 4 Shoe Men's
sections.body: The long-distance shoe designed to adapt to all your training and adventure runs over mud, roots, and rocks. The spacious forefoot and secure midfoot hold deliver comfort and stability, the mud-releasing lug pattern gives you the control to rip and grip across any terrain, and the durable upper and Vibram® Megagrip outsole stand up to unforgiving rock and soft trails. Size and fit tip: We've heard that this product runs large. Please refer to the sizing chart to find your foot length, then we recommend choosing a half size down. Need a waterproof version? Try the Norvan LD 4 GTX Shoe .

sections.heading: Kragg Shoe Men's
sections.body: Comfort and freedom, support and protection – the Kragg erases the need to choose between flimsy flip-flops and rigid approach shoes. The upper is a single layer of breathable, stretchy Spacermesh that wraps the foot for a custom fit. TPU and Vibram rubber provide zonal protection at the toe and other high-wear areas. When in motion, an elastic gore secures the comfortable fit, and for recovery, the heel collapses to create a slide. A Vibram Megagrip outsole holds tight across a range of surfaces.

X000010174.tagline: Adaptable mountain running shoe for confidence in harsh winter conditions.

sections.heading: Norvan 4 Nivalis GTX Grotto Shoe Women's
sections.body: Run through the winter in the Norvan Nivalis. The stable, adaptable Norvan, built for varied terrain, gets a watertight upgrade with a GORE-TEX upper cover and over-ankle gaiter to seal out snow and water, keeping your feet dry. Tread confidently on snow and mud with winter-optimized outsole lugs, and when it’s icy, easily add carbide spikes or slip on microspikes. When winter is at its harshest, don't break stride—the Norvan Nivalis is your weatherproof standby.

Balancing the fit and performance of a trail running shoe with the stability required for long days on technical terrain, it’s light, fast, waterproof and combines support and protection with a secure, comfortable ride. A full GORE-TEX liner seals out wet and snow, and the sticky Vibram XS Flash 2 outsole is designed for edging, on-trail performance, and grip in wet and dry conditions. A TPU shank and toe cap add protection, and a knit collar seals out debris. What's been updated: Updated with a PFCec-Free DWR (Durable Water Repellent) treatment. Need a non-waterproof version? Try the Vertex Alpine Shoe .

sections.heading: Sabre Bib Pant Men's
sections.body: Moving beyond boundaries, always seeking something new – if freeride’s your path, the Sabre’s your bib. Built to handle backcountry realities – and great for a day carving turns at the resort – it leverages durable, breathable 80D 3L ePE GORE-TEX to shut out sleet, snow, and wind. A warm backer adds light insulation. Thigh vents dump heat on the uptrack, articulation frees you to move, a RECCO® reflector’s embedded for added safety, and the full bib adds protection in deep powder. What's been updated: Updated with a new durable, lightweight GORE-TEX ePE fabric that offers a reduced carbon footprint and has an 80D face fabric for enhanced durability without added weight. This product is free of intentionally added PFAS. The new ePE membrane technology is lighter and thinner, but just as strong and durable as the materials we used before. You may notice the face fabric “wetting out” slightly faster in products with ePE membranes, but rest assured this does not affect the waterproofing of the membrane itself. If you notice the fabric wetting out faster than you’d like, simply wash the jacket and dry it to remove the oil contamination and bring the DWR back to its full power.

sections.heading: Monitor Coat Men's
sections.body: The Monitor is an everyday, relaxed-fit shell, featured to keep you dry as you move through city storms. What's been updated: Updated with a FC0 DWR finish and PFAS-free GORE-TEX ePE laminate for a lower footprint. This product is free of intentionally added PFAS. You may notice the face fabric “wetting out” slightly faster in products with ePE membranes, but rest assured this does not affect the waterproofing of the membrane itself. If you notice the fabric wetting out faster than you’d like, simply wash the jacket and dry it to remove the oil contamination and bring the DWR back to its full power.

sections.heading: Product details
sections.body: The Beta SL Jacket – our lightest Beta – is built for mountain realities. Highly versatile, it’s carefully designed to deliver complete waterproof, windproof, breathable protection without sacrificing lightweight packability. Its innovative GORE-TEX ePE membrane is light, strong, and PFC free. C-KNIT backer technology improves comfort and breathability. The helmet-compatible StormHood protects without compromising vision, pit zippers ventilate, and a RECCO reflector can aid in search situations. This product is free of intentionally added PFAS. The new ePE membrane technology is lighter and thinner, but just as strong and durable as the materials we used before.   You may notice the face fabric “wetting out” slightly faster in products with ePE membranes, but rest assured this does not affect the waterproofing of the membrane itself. If you notice the fabric wetting out faster than you’d like, simply wash the jacket and dry it to remove the oil contamination and bring the DWR back to its full power.

sections.heading: Product details
sections.body: Lighter than the original, the Atom SL Hoody is one of the most useful (and packable) pieces you can own. Wear it as a standalone layer when trail runs take you through cold, wet weather or layer it with a waterproof shell when mountain pursuits demand additional warmth and mobility. Breathable and weather-resistant, it has stretch insulation in the body but not the sleeves or hood — maximizing packability while still delivering focused warmth to your core. X000009106.title: Sentinel Bib Pant Women's
X000009106.tagline: GORE-TEX bib for the back country and resort.

sections.heading: Product details
sections.body: Powder days are bib days. Made for freeriders looking for the steep and deep, the Sentinel’s breathable GORE-TEX fabric has a durable 80D face, shuts out wind and snow, and is PFAS-free for lighter footprint. A brushed backer adds comfort. Thigh vents release heat on uptracks, RECCO technology can aid in search situations, a drop seat speeds pit stops, and the pockets are ample and organized. Articulated for the snow, the Sentinel gives you freedom to move on backcountry tours or days at the resort. What's been updated: Updated with a new GORE-TEX ePE fabric with a more durable 80D recycled face, recycled C-KNIT backer, and a PFAS-free waterproof, breathable laminate. This product is free of intentionally added PFAS. The new ePE membrane technology is lighter and thinner, but just as strong and durable as the materials we used before.   You may notice the face fabric “wetting out” slightly faster in products with ePE membranes, but rest assured this does not affect the waterproofing of the membrane itself. If you notice the fabric wetting out faster than you’d like, simply wash the jacket and dry it to remove the oil contamination and bring the DWR back to its full power.
